50:36.text: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in
power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?

50:37.text: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present

50:38.text: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

50:39.text: , over what they say and exalt
with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,

50:40.text: of the night exalt Him and after prostration

50:41.text: And listen on the Day when the Caller
will call out from a place that is near -

50:42.text: The Day they will hear the blast
in truth. That is the Day of Emergence

50:43.text: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

50:44.text: On the Day the earth breaks away from them
rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.

50:45.text: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant.
But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.

51:3.text: And the ships sailing with ease

51:5.text: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

51:6.text: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
